section: Cobalt Electroplating Interconnects in Advanced Chip Fabrication: A Review > Abstract
text: Electroplating is a core technology in high-end chip manufacturing, with its technical challenges centered on achieving voidfree filling of metal coatings within micro- and nanoscale trenches and vias. Copper, the current mainstream interconnect material, can no longer meet the performance and reliability demands posed by the continuous reduction in interconnect dimensions. In contrast, cobalt ofers superior electrical properties and safety at the micro-/nanoscale, making it a promising next-generation interconnect material to replace copper.

text: Electroplating is a critical technology in high-end electronic manufacturing, including integrated circuits. Cobalt, with its superior electrical properties and safety at the micro-/nanoscale, is emerging as a promising next-generation interconnect material to replace copper.
